messages.en:
{07 1b 00}So {01 00 00 0a 00}you were really great!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Maybe you're better at
nabbing bugs than sweeties?
{07 00 00}I'm going to finish my bug
catching today, {07 14 00}but keep up
your good work! {01 00 00 0a 00}Good luck!
messages.et:
{07 1b 00}Sa {01 00 00 0a 00}olid tõesti suurepärane!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Ehk oled putukapüüdjana
parem kui maiasmokana?
{07 00 00}Ma lõpetan täna putukate
püüdmise, {07 14 00}aga jätka
sina! {01 00 00 0a 00}Edu!

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}It's clear{01 00 00 05 00} that you're some
kind of bug-catching
savant or something{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 00 00}You're the kind of person
who sucks up the passion
from those around you, 
and uses it as fuel to
reach your goal by
yourself{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 19 00}It's true.
{07 1b 00}Well, thanks to you, I've
completely lost interest in
bugs, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}It's time for me to find
a new and better hobby.{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}Thanks for everything.
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}On selge,{01 00 00 05 00} et sa oled mingi
putukapüügi
imelaps või midagi{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
{07 00 00}Sa oled see inimene,
kes imeb enda ümbert
kire välja,
ja kasutab seda kütusena,
et üksinda oma eesmärgini
jõuda{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 01 00} {07 19 00}See on tõsi.
{07 1b 00}Noh, tänu sulle olen ma
täiesti kaotanud huvi
putukate vastu, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}On aeg leida uus ja
parem hobi.{01 01 00}
{07 00 00}Aitäh kõige eest.
